text:
kevin: heads-up: us-west GPU warm pool showing 18% bootstrap failures starting ~03:12 UTC, correlated with a firewall rule push.
nina: saw `KMS:Decrypt` denies and STS assumeRole rejects in the trace. error: `AccessDenied: KMS access denied for arn:aws:iam::111:role/gpu-node-role`.
omar: logs show recent firewall PR `fw-tighten-egress-usw` also modified route for privatelink subnet -> natgw rotation. Could be a timing/routing hole.
audit-bot: CloudTrail: 7 KMS Decrypt denies between 03:11:25 - 03:18:03, caller: ec2 i-0f3..., sourceVpc: vpc-89abc, vpce: vpce-0a1, keyId: key/boot-77. Note: no PutObject entries to s3://audit-shipper/usw for 06m.
kevin: so two suspects: key policy change `kms-boot-policy-2026-03-21` and the privatelink/nat rotation. we rolled the key policy 03:10 UTC.
nina: stack traces: pv-provisioner calls assumeRole -> then calls keystore to decrypt bootstrap secret via vpce. the vpce source id in CT is vpce-0a1 but our new key policy checks `aws:SourceVpc` only. vpce->sourceVpc mapping changed during the VPC migration.
omar: temporary mitigation idea: add explicit key policy allow for gpu-node-role principal for Decrypt (short-lived) and relax the SourceVpc condition. then pin audit shipper egress so we can see full traces.
ops-runbook-bot: recommended steps: 1) apply canary key policy override to 10% of nodes, 2) add temporary egress exception for audit shipper, 3) set warm-pool desired -20% to reduce retry cost.
kevin: executing canary now. CLI: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id boot-77 --policy-name canary-override --policy-document file://canary.json` where canary allows `arn:aws:iam::111:role/gpu-node-role` Decrypt.
deploy-bot: canary deployed at 2026-03-21T03:25:44Z. monitoring.
audit-bot: audit egress rule reopened for privatelink subnet -> s3 collector (collector-usw.redwood:443). logs resumed. CT records show some failed Decrypt calls originated from old-vpc id vpc-12old.
nina: canary results: bootstrap failures in canary slice dropped 18% -> 1.8% in ~80s. joins latency improved 2.4s -> 500ms. One AZ still shows sporadic STS denies.
omar: NAT gateway in that AZ reported `conntrack_reclaim` spikes at 03:20-03:30. I suspect ephemeral port exhaustion because warm pool churn + audit uploads concurrent. I'll route collector traffic via a dedicated ENI to reduce ephemeral consumption.
kevin: cost impact: warm-pool inflated + retries estimating +$3.6k/day if not contained. propose to scale down desired by 25% during rollout.
ops-runbook-bot: add step: after stable 10m, roll to 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m checks. Also create follow-up ticket to replace SourceVpc condition with `aws:VpcEndpointId` in KMS policies.
nina: created ticket INFRA-USW-901: replace VPC-based KMS conditions, add unit test for VPC rename/VPCE mapping.
omar: route change applied to pin collector to eni-0f2 for privatelink subnet; conntrack spikes subsided.
deploy-bot: rollout 30% -> success. no new KMS denies in slices for 7m.
kevin: expanding to 60% now. keeping audit egress open until postmortem.
ops-runbook-bot: reminder: capture cost delta and tag `sre-cost` and add a short postmortem when stable.
nina: final plan summary posted: 1) short-term key-policy canary -> full rollback to remove SourceVpc-only restriction, 2) open audit egress and pin collector ENI, 3) reduce warm pool desired by 25% while rolling, 4) follow-ups: endpoint-based KMS condition + egress smoke tests in PR gating.
kevin: thanks team. rolling to 100% now. closing watch in 15m.
